format: Studio / Custom events: scoring-heat capacity and the deterministic floor planner
requirement: DanceFlow product default (not a sanctioning rule): scoring-heat capacity is configurable per round (1..100, default 8 via DEFAULT_SCORING_HEAT_CAPACITY); the 10D floor planner is deterministic: it splits a division by capacity in entry order (first-fit; 9 entries give heats of 8 and 1, not balanced) without putting one competitor twice in a scoring heat. The callback-Final capacity guard keeps target_capacity between 1 and 100. Preserved unchanged by OD-25 Option B.

implementation.symbol_or_migration: default scoring-heat capacity 8 (comment: product default, NOT a sanctioning rule)

enforcement_point: src/lib/competition/floorPlanner.ts buildFloorPlan; apply_competition_floor_plan and integrity triggers in 20261111090000; callback target_capacity check in 20270120090000.

tests.name: splits a division into scoring heats by capacity (default 8, editable per round) without double-booking

interpretation_notes: The label 'DanceFlow product default, NOT a sanctioning rule' exists in code comments, the 10D document and the SQL comment; no user-facing label was verified. Behavior is covered by a floorPlanner test, which was not run for this docs-only entry. Not any body's rule; it differs from UCWDC Heating Rules 2 and 7 (heat sizes within one) and is not an NDCA limit.
